discussion.body: Build study, not clothes. Same face as the existing Cael plates (harvest squire, brown hair). Athletic farm-and-road muscle, medium human height, not Halric-bulk. Hip wrap only so the next pass can cloth Act 0 homespun vs late Gate coat. Local: artifacts/Concept art/FEAT-027-cael-ward-build-study.jpg. Existing clothed plates stay.
